name: Sour taste and pH-sensing ion channels
rationale: All members concern sensing of acid/pH (sour taste, acidic pH response, TRP and alkaline-activated TALK channels), distinguishing it from other taste/olfaction themes, from the other K2P channel families, and from CFTR anion transport.

name: Glucose-6-phosphate handling and regulation of glycogen turnover
rationale: Members cover glucose-6-phosphate production, transport and hydrolysis (glucokinase/GKRP, G6PC, G6PC3, SLC37A4) and regulation of glycogen synthesis and breakdown, unlike neighbours focused on glycolysis, glucagon/PKA signalling, gluconeogenesis/fructose, or glycogen synthesis disorders.

name: Membrane glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid metabolism
rationale: Members span synthesis, acyl-chain remodelling, transfer and catabolism of glycerophospholipids together with sphingomyelin/ceramide metabolism, the sphingolipid part being absent from all confusables (which add ether lipids, endocannabinoids or DAG/TAG).

name: snoRNP assembly and Cajal body RNA targeting
rationale: Members concern snoRNA/scaRNA RNP assembly, folding and localization to Cajal bodies for snRNA and rRNA modification, unlike neighbours centred on telomerase/rRNA processing, RNA polymerase transcription or modification enzymes themselves.

name: Intestinal and renal hexose and urate transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated hexose (glucose, galactose, fructose) and urate transport and their absorption/reabsorption disorders, distinct from carbohydrate digestion and amino acid/cystine transport neighbours.

name: Neutral amino acid and oligopeptide membrane transport
rationale: Members are transport of neutral amino acids and di/oligopeptides (SLC6A19, SLC6A20, SLC36A2, SLC6A14, proton-coupled carriers) and their aminoaciduria disorders, unlike neighbours on cationic amino acids, cystine or urate.

name: Antifungal and peptidoglycan-targeting antimicrobial host defense
rationale: Members describe killing and cytolysis of microbes, antifungal and Gram-positive defense, metal sequestration and peptidoglycan metabolism, distinguishing it from defensin, mucosal-attachment and Gram-negative/neutrophil-killing neighbours.

qualifier: in antibody diversification and HIV early infection
name: AID/APOBEC deamination in antibody diversification and HIV infection
rationale: Members combine AID-driven somatic hypermutation, class switching and B cell development with APOBEC3G restriction and the HIV early life cycle (entry, reverse transcription, integration), unlike neighbours on HIV late events, ADAR A-to-I editing or retroelement silencing.

name: LDL receptor degradation limiting lipoprotein uptake
rationale: Members concern lysosomal degradation and reduced recycling of LDLR/VLDLR that limits LDL clearance and cholesterol uptake, distinct from receptor endocytosis and SREBP/cholesterol-synthesis neighbours.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and keratan sulfate glycosylation
rationale: Members are DAG1 O-mannosyl glycan/matriglycan synthesis and its dystroglycanopathies plus keratan sulfate synthesis and degradation, distinct from muscle-development neighbours and other glycosaminoglycan (CS/DS/HS) pathways.

name: Lung and trachea morphogenesis and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, vasculature, saccules, pneumocyte differentiation and trachea/diaphragm formation, distinct from salivary branching, bronchial epithelium and surfactant neighbours.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate and GDP-mannose donor synthesis
rationale: Members concern synthesis of dolichyl phosphate, GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose and the corresponding CDGs (DOLK, DPM1-3, MPI, PMM2, PGM1, DHDDS, SRD5A3), unlike neighbours on GPI anchors, UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid or ALG oligosaccharide assembly.

name: Actin remodeling in filopodia and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members regulate filopodium assembly, postsynaptic actin, dendrite branching and spine morphogenesis (RHOF, EPHB), distinct from postsynaptic density, microtubule and BDNF/TRKB neighbours.

name: Phospholipid remodeling and endocannabinoid lipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover acyl-chain remodelling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis plus DAG/MAG catabolism and NAPE/NAE endocannabinoid metabolism, unlike neighbours on de novo phospholipid synthesis, sphingolipids or PAF/ether lipids.

qualifier: glucosylation and mannose trimming to hybrid/complex glycans
name: N-glycan glucosylation, trimming and hybrid/complex processing
rationale: Members concern glucose donors, glucose/mannose trimming (MOGS, MAN1B1) and hybrid/complex N-glycan processing and degradation, distinct from UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid, nucleotide-sugar transport and O-glycan neighbours.

name: Acylglycerol synthesis and triglyceride lipolysis
rationale: Members cover the PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis pathway and lipase-mediated triglyceride breakdown, unlike neighbours focused on lipid droplet organization, lipophagy and adipocyte storage regulation.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT and cardiac valve-septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern endocardial cushion EMT, valve and membranous/muscular septum formation and great artery development, distinct from myocardial/ventricular and neural crest outflow tract neighbours.

name: Autophagosome assembly regulation and ER/nuclear selective autophagy
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly, maturation and cargo recruitment together with reticulophagy and nucleophagy, distinct from mitophagy, pexophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy neighbours.

name: Chylomicron and VLDL remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members cover lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance of chylomicrons and VLDL, distinct from LDL/HDL remodelling, intestinal lipid absorption/assembly and LXR transcriptional neighbours.

name: Histone and non-histone protein acetylation
rationale: Members concern lysine, N-terminal and histone acetylation and its regulation, distinct from histone methylation, chromatin remodelling and heat-shock neighbours.

qualifier: spinal cord motor neuron and interneuron specification
name: Spinal cord patterning and motor neuron specification
rationale: Members concern dorsoventral neural tube patterning and fate specification of spinal motor neurons and interneurons, distinct from neural plate/axial, forebrain and cortical migration neighbours.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthase and its glycosylation disorders
rationale: All members concern dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthase (DPM1-3) and its CDGs, distinct from GDP-mannose, ALG and other CDG neighbours.

name: Cytolytic and antifungal antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members describe killing and cytolysis of microbes, antifungal and Gram-positive defense, neutrophil cytotoxicity and metal sequestration, distinct from defensin, mucosal attachment, antimicrobial peptide production and respiratory-burst neighbours.

name: Catecholamine transporter-mediated uptake and vesicular loading
rationale: Members concern dopamine/norepinephrine/monoamine transport, DAT and NET reuptake and their disorders and synaptic vesicle loading, distinct from dopamine receptor signalling and dopamine biosynthesis neighbours.

qualifier: sodium-phosphate transport in bone and tooth
name: Sodium-phosphate transport and bone and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members cover Na+/Pi cotransport and its disorders, FGF-Klotho/PTH regulation and bone, dentin and enamel mineralization, distinct from vitamin D, bicarbonate/pH and odontogenesis neighbours.
